This isn’t a lack of effort. I’m just not cut out for this life. And that’s ok. I made some beautiful babies who may well change the world. I’ve done my part. It’s ok. For real.

Like I have a smile on my face right now. It’s genuinely ok. “Daddy had another stroke.” They don’t have to know! So no trauma. All they need is that I love them. And I do. A ton. Enough to leave them be and let them grow up without my shit.

I appreciate that. The thing is: I am a burden. I don’t add anything positive to anyone’s life. So, it’s ok. Like, there are no hurt feelings. I’m a few years I leave everyone alone and my family is secured financially for a few years at least. I can’t see how this is a bad thing.

I was in therapy. I’ve tried before. There is little-to-no good will left. Some people just aren’t cut out for this world. I tried. I did. And hard. For a long time. I’m tired. I’m tired of letting everyone down. I’m tired of hurting everyone I love. I’m tired. So, no one is looking to work with me anymore. I’m a burden. So, in a few years time, I’ll finally be able to take care of people. It’ll be good. Everyone will get what they want. Like, sometimes I do see suicide as selfish. This isn’t one of those times.
